---
title: "QoL death-inclusive longitudinal Markov — computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)
models QoL states 1–7 together with absorbing death state 8. Missing QoL values
are imputed only on weeks known to be alive. Fixed imputations 1–5 and 200
posterior standardized draws per imputation are required.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))
runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
if (!requireNamespace("miceadds", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'miceadds' is required for multilevel QoL imputation.")
library(miceadds)
indices <- module_exact_indices(config, supporting = TRUE)
if (!identical(indices, 1:5)) stop("Supporting death-inclusive QoL requires exactly imputations 1:5.")
input_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "death-inclusive-prepared.parquet")
output_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "supporting", "qol-death-inclusive-longitudinal"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-death-inclusive-qol
#| include: false
prepared <- module_read_parquet(input_path)
module_require_columns(prepared, c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "week", "q30", "y_death_inclusive"), "death-inclusive QoL data")
for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  sops_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("sops-%02d.rds", index))
  comparison_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("comparisons-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("supporting-qol-death-inclusive-%02d", index),
    input_paths = input_path,
    output_paths = c(model_path, sops_path, comparison_path, draws_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(label = "computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)",
                   imputation = index, imputations = 1:5, posterior_draws = 200L,
                   absorbing_state = 8L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- prepared
      data$.cluster <- as.integer(factor(data$id))
      data$q30_model <- ifelse(data$y_death_inclusive == 8L, NA_real_, data$q30)
      init <- mice::mice(data, m = 0, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
      methods <- init$method
      predictors <- init$predictorMatrix
      methods[] <- ""
      methods["q30_model"] <- "2l.pmm"
      predictors[,] <- 0
      predictors["q30_model", c("week", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt")] <- 1
      predictors["q30_model", ".cluster"] <- -2
      predictors[, c("id", ".cluster", "q30", "y_death_inclusive", "death_week")] <- 0
      predictors[c("id", ".cluster", "q30", "y_death_inclusive", "death_week"), ] <- 0
      fitted <- mice::mice(
        data = data,
        method = methods,
        predictorMatrix = predictors,
        m = 1L,
        maxit = as.integer(config$imputation$supporting$maxit),
        donors = as.integer(config$imputation$supporting$donors),
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index),
        printFlag = FALSE
      )
      completed <- mice::complete(fitted, action = 1L)
      completed$y <- ifelse(
        completed$y_death_inclusive == 8L,
        8L,
        q30_to_analysis_state(completed$q30_model, strict = TRUE)
      )
      completed <- completed |>
        dplyr::arrange(id, week) |>
        dplyr::group_by(id) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          death_seen = dplyr::cumany(y == 8L),
          y = dplyr::if_else(death_seen, 8L, y),
          yprev = dplyr::lag(y, 1L, default = dplyr::first(y)),
          gap = 1L
        ) |>
        dplyr::ungroup()
      completed$death_seen <- NULL
      completed$y <- factor(completed$y, levels = 1:8, ordered = TRUE)
      completed$yprev <- factor(completed$yprev, levels = 1:8, ordered = FALSE)
      observed <- completed[!duplicated(completed$id), c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "yprev", "gap"), drop = FALSE]
      dd <- rms::datadist(completed)
      old_datadist <- getOption("datadist")
      options(datadist = "dd")
      on.exit(options(datadist = old_datadist), add = TRUE)
      model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev * gap +
        ecog_fstcnt + factor(diagnosis)
      fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
      fitted_model <- tryCatch(
        markov.misc::blrm_markov(
          formula = model_formula,
          ppo = ~week,
          cppo = function(y) y,
          data = completed,
          id_var = "id",
          time_var = "week",
          chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
          iter = as.integer(config$markov$iterations),
          warmup = as.integer(config$markov$warmup),
          seed = fit_seed,
          refresh = 0L
        ),
        error = identity
      )
      diagnostics <- if (inherits(fitted_model, "error")) {
        fitted_model
      } else {
        tryCatch(markov_diagnostics(fitted_model, config$diagnostics), error = identity)
      }
      retry <- inherits(fitted_model, "error") || inherits(diagnostics, "error") ||
        !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)
      if (retry) {
        if (!isTRUE(config$diagnostics$retry_on_failure)) {
          stop("Supporting death-inclusive QoL Markov fit failed and retries are disabled.")
        }
        fitted_model <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
          formula = model_formula,
          ppo = ~week,
          cppo = function(y) y,
          data = completed,
          id_var = "id",
          time_var = "week",
          chains = as.integer(config$markov$chains),
          iter = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations),
          warmup = as.integer(config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L),
          seed = as.integer(fit_seed + 500000L),
          refresh = 0L
        )
        diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fitted_model, config$diagnostics)
      }
      assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
      sops <- markov.misc::avg_sops(
        model = fitted_model,
        newdata = observed,
        variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
        times = 1:26,
        y_levels = 1:8,
        absorb = 8L,
        p_var = "yprev",
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        n_draws = 200L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index),
        posterior_summary = "mean",
        return_draws = TRUE
      )
      comparisons <- markov.misc::avg_comparisons(
        model = fitted_model,
        newdata = observed,
        variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
        estimand = "time_in_state",
        state_sets = 1:3,
        times = 1:26,
        y_levels = 1:8,
        absorb = 8L,
        id_var = "id",
        time_var = "week",
        p_var = "yprev",
        include_re = FALSE,
        n_draws = 200L,
        seed = fit_seed,
        posterior_summary = "mean",
        return_draws = TRUE
      )
      module_save_rds(fitted_model, model_path)
      module_save_rds(sops, sops_path)
      module_save_rds(comparisons, comparison_path)
      draws <- attr(sops, "draws")
      if (is.null(draws) || nrow(draws) < 200L) stop("Death-inclusive QoL SOPs contain fewer than 200 draws.")
      module_save_parquet(as.data.frame(draws), draws_path)
    }
  )
}
```
